# Infoscend — Commercial Intelligence Platform

> Infoscend is the AI-powered commercial intelligence platform for companies that distribute through third-party networks. One platform covering distribution management, sales force automation, competitive intelligence, AI insights, trade marketing, and retailer loyalty. Tagline: Strategy flows down. Intelligence flows up. The loop closes.

## Brand

- Name: Infoscend (pronounced in-fo-send)
- Etymology: info + scend (the upward lift of a wave — information ascending)
- Tagline: Strategy flows down. Intelligence flows up. The loop closes.
- Voice: practitioner-direct, numbers-first, no marketing softeners

## Core Products

- **Distribution Management System (DMS)**: Multi-tenant, multi-distributor operational backbone. Orders, billing, inventory, credit limits, batch tracking, warehouse operations. ROIC-based distributor viability measurement. Financial controls with WAC, banker's rounding, configurable tax.
- **Sales Force Automation (SFA)**: Mobile-first field app for distributor sales representatives. AI pitch recommendations, GPS-verified visits, voice journaling, offline-first architecture, smart route planning. Captures field intelligence that feeds back into the platform.
- **Competitive Intelligence Pipeline**: Reps photograph competitor price lists in the field. AI extracts prices, matches to catalogue, validates against baselines, flags anomalies. Pricing aspiration matrix for competitive positioning.
- **AI Insights & Analytics**: Performance command centre, distributor health scoring, attrition risk prediction, demand forecasting, natural language queries, AI insight cards. Executive dashboards with self-serve report builder.
- **Trade Marketing & Digital**: Promotion simulation with AI-predicted ROI. Campaign builder with push-to-serve across Meta, Google, TikTok, Shopee/Lazada. Creative asset management. Full campaign attribution.
- **Retailer Loyalty & Trade App**: Mobile app for retailers. Multi-brand loyalty, QR scan-to-earn, order history, reward redemption. Direct brand-to-outlet relationship.

## Key Differentiators

- Diagnosis-to-configuration: RTM assessment findings automatically seed module configurations
- ROIC-based viability: distributor relationships measured by return on invested capital, not gross margin
- Ground truth: GPS-verified visits, AI-analysed shelf photos, system-ingested sell-out data
- Three-tier AI learning: prompt improvement, codified rules, deterministic pattern bypass
- Adoption as design problem: field app faster than the rep's paper book, offline-first, multilingual, one-thumb operation

## Architecture

- Four operating loops with AI reasoning at the centre:
  - Loop 01 Commercial leadership: strategy → cascade → execution
  - Loop 02 Brand marketing: brief → push → attribution
  - Loop 03 Field intelligence: capture → extract → claim
  - Loop 04 Trade marketing: promo → ROI → sell-through

## Target Market

FMCG, lubricants, automotive aftermarket, hardware, industrial chemicals, pharma distribution, consumer durables — any company distributing through third-party networks. Typical buyer: Founder/GM, Country Sales Director, Strategy VP, or Commercial Director.
